data.text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY (Northwest Knox) - KUB crews will implement a temporary road closure on a short section of Richmond Avenue between Sterchi Street and Tennessee Avenue from 8 a.m. – 3 p.m. on Monday, February 9, as work is performed on the water and wastewater systems. Alternate routes include Sterchi Street, Tennessee Avenue, and Richmond Avenue. Traffic control measures, including flaggers, barricades, and signage, will be in place to assist with maintaining traffic flow. Access to driveways and businesses will be maintained.
